label.text: 搜索已保存的论文和笔记

guidance.source: Search titles, authors, DOI/arXiv IDs, years, venues, links or saved notes. All words must match. Latin accents are optional. Search stays in this tab.
guidance.text: 搜索标题、作者、DOI/arXiv 标识符、年份、发表场所、链接或已保存的笔记。所有搜索词都须匹配。拉丁字母可省略重音。搜索词仅保留在当前标签页中。

scope.source: Reference downloads contain only papers shown by both search and screening. CSV and JSON backup contain all saved papers. Notes stay out of reference downloads.
scope.text: 参考文献下载仅包含同时符合搜索和筛选条件的可见论文。CSV 和 JSON 备份包含全部已保存论文。参考文献下载不含笔记。

empty.source: No saved papers match this search and screening filter.
empty.text: 没有已保存论文符合当前搜索和筛选条件。

outsideSearch.source: Outside the current search; still selected.
outsideSearch.text: 不在当前搜索结果中；仍已选中。
